_about: Barter screen and partners. The partners are groups of people at a place, not named real individuals.
barter.griqua_philippolis.greeting: "Coin? Out here coin is worth little. Show us what you have, and we will see what we can do."
barter.griqua_philippolis.needs: "Tobacco and cloth, coffee and sugar, iron. Powder most of all, but you know the Governor's law on that."
barter.barolong_thaba_nchu.greeting: Through an interpreter: "We have cattle and grain. What do you bring?"
barter.barolong_thaba_nchu.needs: "Beads, good beads, and cloth. Tobacco we grow ourselves now. Iron is useful. And powder, of course."
barter.basotho_caledon.greeting: Men from Moshoeshoe's country have brought grain down to the drift to trade.
barter.basotho_caledon.needs: "Beads and cloth, iron for hoes. Tobacco too."
barter.trekkers_sand_river.greeting: "Neighbour, what have you got? We have oxen, but coffee and sugar we have not seen in weeks."
barter.trekkers_sand_river.needs: "Coffee! And sugar, tobacco, cloth for the children. Powder and lead, always."
barter.title: Barter
barter.contraband: Selling gunpowder beyond the frontier is against the law, and the trekkers do not like it either.
barter.footer: Left/right: switch side  Up/down: choose  +/-: more or less  P: propose  A: ask  Esc: leave
barter.reply.empty: "Put something on the blanket first, then we can talk."
barter.reply.insult: They laugh and shake their heads. "That is not a trade."
barter.reply.short: "A little more, and we have a deal."
barter.reply.done: Hands are shaken. The goods change hands.
barter.reply.generous: "You trade fairly." They will remember it.
barter.reply.powder: The deal is done, and the powder goes with it. Word of this will travel.
journal.barter_powder: Traded goods with {partner}, including gunpowder, against the Colony's law.
